objective: Keep ActionResult execution evidence separate from observed world state in the Dashboard: action results never move a map entity, canonical outcome/dispatch_state/device_state are rendered as execution evidence, and only an accepted Observation may establish or change an entity location.
decision_supported: Can the Dashboard display completed action results as execution evidence while the observed map, the observed location and the per-claim verification verdict stay derived exclusively from accepted Observation events?
acceptance: an ActionResult never changes an entity observed location, pose, confidence or observation evidence in the Dashboard
canonical outcome, dispatch_state and device_state are rendered separately as execution evidence
a completed execution without a newer accepted observation keeps the last observed location and shows awaiting observation or unverified
a newer supporting observation resolves the claim as supported, while a contradictory observation stays visibly contradicted
fixtures use canonical ActionResult fields and every displayed new world fact is backed by an explicit post-action observation
replay at every cursor position preserves the execution versus observation distinction
tests fail if action results alone move a map entity
evidence: Node-evaluated buildWorkbenchState output per fixture cursor showing locations derived only from observations
Mutation probe output: restoring the action_result location assignment fails the map-entity test
Mutation probe output: judging a claim against the newest observation instead of its own window fails the window tests
Targeted pytest output with the collected Issue #179 test names, pass counts and exit codes
make test, make contract, make scenario-check, make golden-check and make context-check output with exit codes
final git diff --check and git diff --name-only output proving every changed path is allowed
stop_conditions: the change requires modifying the World Model reducer, a shared schema or a libs/contracts Pydantic model
the change requires a new world fact that no committed observation supports
the Dashboard would gain a control, ROS, MCU, motion or emergency-stop publisher
an existing fixture meaning must change without a matching explicit post-action observation
a required modification falls outside allowed_paths
risks_and_fallbacks: Fixtures gain post-action observations so displayed world facts stay evidence-backed; entities whose placement is never observed keep the last observed location instead of the claimed one.
The hold claims of run-confirmed and run-recovery stay unverified because no observation ever confirms held:gripper. This is reported, not hidden.
Claim verification is evaluated per entity inside the window between an action result and the entity next action result, so a later placement supersedes an earlier hold instead of contradicting it.
Node is required to execute the dashboard module. The focused test module skips itself when node is unavailable rather than reporting a false pass.
The parcel post-action observations carry the same observed attributes as the intake observations so the routing decisions panel keeps its evidence.
